about: Which modelled cases have no scenario, and why. Every other case in spec/*/expected.json must be named in the `covers` list of at least one scenario; tools/check_repo.py enforces that.

not_covered.kernel/design: A search of the whole state space, not a behaviour. The scenarios sample it.
not_covered.kernel/assumption_undeclared_dep: About a provider declaring too few dependencies. A kernel cannot detect that from its inputs; it is a provider conformance case.
not_covered.kernel/assumption_flaky_provider: About a provider giving a wrong verdict. A kernel cannot detect that; the conflict scenario covers what the kernel does when verdicts disagree.
not_covered.intent/design_three_criteria: A search of the whole state space, not a behaviour.
